region.name: Jezero Crater floor at the western delta front, including the Perseverance landing site
region.landing_site_note: Mars 2020 Perseverance landing site (Octavia E. Butler Landing), per NASA JPL.
region.frame: x = east (m), z = south (m), origin at region centre; row 0 = north edge
region.elevation_reference: Mars 2000 sphere, heights referenced to the MOLA areoid (per source metadata)

processing: Region bounds transformed into each source CRS by GDAL; only that window is read (HTTP range requests for remote files).
HiRISE 1 m DTM block-averaged (GDAL 'average') onto the 5 m local grid; cells with no HiRISE data filled from the CTX 20 m DTM (cubic).
Fine slope: slope of the native 1 m HiRISE DTM (ground-corrected for the equirectangular x stretch), third-quartile (GDAL q3) resample per 5 m cell.
Heights stored relative to datum_offset_m so the 3D scene stays near the origin; true elevation = height + datum_offset_m.
HiRISE 25 cm orthoimage area-averaged to 4096 x 4096 (0.49 m/px) and contrast-stretched (0.5-99.5 percentile). Grayscale, not colour.
THEMIS day-IR mosaic resampled (bilinear) to 64 x 64 for a display layer; values are 8-bit brightness, not calibrated temperature.
Mars 2020 traverse, waypoints and Ingenuity flights (NASA/JPL MMGIS GeoJSON) projected into the local frame; rover elevations checked against the HiRISE terrain.
Mars 2020 traverse, waypoints and Ingenuity flights (NASA/JPL MMGIS GeoJSON) projected into the local frame; rover elevations checked against the HiRISE terrain.

Surroundings: 80 km square of the Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM (decimated, bilinear) and orthoimage (area-averaged) in the same local frame; gaps outside the mosaic smoothly filled; orthoimage colour-mapped with the same ramp as the HiRISE ground.

hazards.label: Crater walls
hazards.note: Inner walls up to ~48 deg in the 5 m HiRISE-derived slope; above the rover limit they are impassable.

hazards.label: Delta front scarp
hazards.note: Scarp of the western delta: ~100 m of relief over a few hundred metres.

sites.name: Perseverance landing site
sites.description: Where NASA's Mars 2020 rover touched down on 18 Feb 2021 (Octavia E. Butler Landing). Coordinates: NASA JPL (18.4447 N, 77.4508 E)

sites.name: Wright Brothers Field
sites.description: Airfield where NASA's Ingenuity helicopter was deployed (sol 43) and made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet (flight 1, sol 58, 19 April 2021). Position: NASA/JPL Mars 2020 localization (18.4449 N, 77.4510 E)

sites.name: Impact crater floor
sites.description: Floor of a ~300 m impact crater, about 26 m below its rim, covered in wind ripples. Measured from the HiRISE DTM (18.4572 N, 77.4411 E)

sites.name: Foot of the delta front
sites.description: Smooth plain below the scarp of Jezero's western delta, the ancient river deposit Perseverance was sent to study (18.4616 N, 77.4277 E)

sites.name: Light-toned rocky ground
sites.description: Bright, blocky surface between ripple fields, visible in the HiRISE orthoimage (18.4477 N, 77.4366 E)

sites.name: Ripple field
sites.description: Dense wind-blown ripples; the 1 m slope data flags this ground as rough (18.4531 N, 77.4455 E)

sites.name: Northeast blocky terrain
sites.description: Fractured light-toned terrain inside a curved boundary, visible in HiRISE (18.4582 N, 77.4526 E)

provenance.source: HiRISE DTM mosaic (MRO), USGS Astrogeology / NASA JPL, with CTX DTM gap fill
provenance.crs: Orthographic on Mars 2000 sphere, centre 18.45313 N 77.44013 E (x east, z south, metres)
provenance.note: Real terrain: Jezero Crater, 2 km square including the Perseverance landing site. HiRISE 1 m DTM averaged to 5 m. Elevation -2583 to -2468 m (heights shown relative to -2583 m). HiRISE-CTX median difference -0.31 m.
